notes: Seed URL works over https (already in the shared cache); results are on page/elections.home (2024) and page/elections.Elections 2026. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Server Last-Modified values differ by file, so upload times are usable. Titus posts Hart cumulative county-total scans on election night (two postings for the 2026 primary: early voting at 8:51 PM and final at 10:27 PM CST) but no precinct-level results for any target election. The home page also links the SOS early-voting site. Run times were read from low-resolution renders where noted. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-4): 2024_general LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2024-11-05 23:53 CT.
tag_rationale: Results: 2024_general LATER, 2026_primary LATER, 2026_runoff LATER. Two or more elections share the result that maps to COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, so the rule gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. (Recomputed under Rule 43, 2026-10-02.)

2024_general.fact: 'November 5, 2024 Unofficial Results' = 14-page scan of Hart 'Cumulative Results Report Titus County 2024 November 5th General Election 11/5/2024 ... Unofficial Results ... Precincts Reporting 34 of 34' (county totals by Absentee/Early/Election Day; run time about 11:53 PM 11/05/2024, low-resolution read); Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 16:20:29 GMT (10:20 AM CST Nov 6). The only other 2024 results file is the 'Canvass Report'. No precinct-by-precinct results are posted (never published online as far as the site shows). Rule 43: county totals first seen 2024-11-05 23:53 CT in Elections_20241106_103205.pdf (printed 'Run Time 11:53 PM Run Date 11/05/2024', confirmed at 250 dpi; no precinct results posted).

2026_primary.fact: 'March 3, 2026 Primary Early Voting Unofficial Results' (scan, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 02:51:35 GMT = 8:51 PM CST) and 'March 3, 2026 Primary Final Unofficial Results' = scanned Hart 'Cumulative Results Report Titus County 2026 Primary Election 3/3/2026 ... Unofficial Results ... Precincts Reporting 19 of 19', county totals by Absentee/Early/Election Day, run time about 9:18 PM 03/03/2026; Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 04:27:11 GMT (10:27 PM CST). No precinct-level primary results are posted.

2026_runoff.fact: 'Unofficial Final Results Page 1/Page 2' (JPEG scans) = Hart 'Cumulative Results Report Titus County 2026 Primary Runoff 5/26/2026 Unofficial Results ... Precincts Reporting 19 of 19 ... Run Time 8:14 PM Run Date 05/26/2026', county totals by Absentee/Early/Election Day; Results 1.jpg Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 02:02:00 GMT (9:02 PM CDT May 26). No precinct-level runoff results are posted.
